stories.title: Six killed and more than a dozen injured in gun attack on Krakow’s Main Market Square
stories.summary: At least six people were killed and more than a dozen injured when a gunman, suspected of far‑right ties, drove into Krakow’s Main Market Square and fired at random from his car shortly before 15:00 local time (14:00 GMT). Police later found three bodies at the suspect’s home during a search. Video showed panic as people fled the scene.
stories.why: The attack highlights public‑safety risks in a major tourist area.
stories.previousTitle: What we know so far after Krakow gun attack
stories.previousSummary: At least six people were killed and more than a dozen others injured when a gunman suspected to have ties to the far-right opened fire in central Krakow, the second largest city in Poland. The attack began shortly before 15:00 local time (14:00 GMT) in Krakow's Main Market Square, the bustling central point of the city which is popular with tourists.

stories.title: Sensex up 320 points, Nifty crosses 25,100 in Muhurat session
stories.summary: The BSE Sensex opened 320 points higher and the NSE Nifty moved above 25,100 in the special Muhurat trading session on Sunday, November 8, as investors marked the start of Samvat 2083. The Nifty had closed Friday at 25,030.35. Tata Steel and Sun Pharma were among the top gainers.
stories.why: The rise reflects investor optimism at the beginning of the new Samvat year, which may influence short‑term market sentiment.
